requested_budget.justification: 5 experiments x 2 members = 10 members, half the declared bound; no filler experiments are proposed to reach the cap.

comparison_pair.provenance: the V2.0.74-promoting matched-arm comparison (exp-proposal-a987db219da2, complexity_premium high): pooled OOF delta +0.023312, moving-block CI [0.008653, 0.036973], block_weeks=4, n_boot=2000, seeds [42,43,44], folds [2023,2024,2025]

baseline.champion_integrity_policy: carried forward unchanged from the frozen C5 config (dual comparison at adjudication; regression flag recorded, never silently overwritten)

derivation_policy.outcome_free_rule: No outcome-dependent quantity (label, hold1_ret, any model score, any prior result.json value) may be consulted in defining, selecting, or ordering the cluster definitions. Labels are read once, inside the harness, only to compute member statistics per the frozen evaluation rules.
derivation_policy.intrinsic_threshold_rule: Every split uses a fixed threshold that is intrinsic to the feature's own scale (0 or {0,1} membership or the 0.5 mid-percentile of a percentile feature, or the 1.0 pivot of a normalized/ATR-multiple feature). No distribution quantile, median, or data-derived constant is used, so no value was picked by looking at the data.
derivation_policy.no_favorable_side_rule: Both sides of every split are predeclared as members; there is no favorable-side selection and no post-hoc renaming.
derivation_policy.design_vocabulary_rule: Each axis comes from the frozen demand-zone design vocabulary that the champion line already models (volatility percentile regime, first-vs-later zone retest, volume confirmation, departure impulse magnitude, departure candle direction). No axis was added because of any measured performance.
derivation_policy.column_verification_readonly: Read-only scale verification at proposal time (2026-10-25): vix_percentile_60d in [0.0167, 1.0] with 0 NaN; zone_is_first_retest and bullish_candle in {0,1} with 0 NaN; relative_volume20 in [0.0, 19.45] with 0 NaN; zone_departure_atr_multiple in [0.1715, 34.28] with 0 NaN. Feature-range checks only; labels were never aggregated for this purpose.

purged_walk_forward.train_rule: train rows require label exit_date < fold start (target-maturity purge, frozen study rule)
purged_walk_forward.oof_rule: scores are out-of-fold only; rows predating the first validation fold train only and are never scored
purged_walk_forward.preprocessing: fit on training fold only (frozen study contract)

evaluation_rules.matched_pair: arm_a == arm_b == C; estimator_a = LogisticRegression; estimator_b = LightGBM; identical folds, seeds, and frame for both pipelines

member_statistic.name: pooled_roc_auc_delta
member_statistic.definition: AUC(score_b) - AUC(score_a) within the cluster member frame (OOF rows only)
member_statistic.signflip_persistence: each member record persists the week-level sign-flip linear form (delta_hat, g vector, n_pos, n_neg, W) exactly as the v1.1.0 family machinery does, so the campaign-end procedure computes the approved p-value from the persisted record with the frozen flip draw

acceptance_model.conditions: both rungs must independently hold point >= 0.0 AND ci_lower >= -0.01 (provisional margins, H-1 provenance)
acceptance_model.undersized_or_underpowered: INCONCLUSIVE, never a pass and never a refutation
acceptance_model.degenerate_cluster: member recorded UNAVAILABLE with reason; counted toward m at p=1.0 per C-2 Option A (strictens Holm, never loosens)

evaluation_rules.champion_rule: V2.0.74 stays the standing champion; these are diagnostics, not promotions. delta_vs_pinned_parent / delta_vs_standing_champion are not applicable and champion_regression is never triggered by a diagnostic run.
evaluation_rules.cal_reporting: per-member Brier and ECE (bins=10, matching the champion evidence era) are persisted as error_cluster_stats but NEVER gated (no calibration margin is valid for per-cluster member counts).
evaluation_rules.point_in_time_audit: the experiment row declares the standard point-in-time data audit (source_vintage, universe_membership, timestamps, label_maturity) before any execution

exclusions: the sealed holdout / prospective set: never opened, never generated, never cited (uses must stay 0)
rows predating the first validation fold: train-only, never scored
clusters whose member frame is degenerate or below the frozen floors: unavailable/INCONCLUSIVE per the frozen model, no substitution
no cross-campaign pooling: the campaign-end record pools ONLY this family's members adjudicated in this resumed C5 execution (pooled_exclusions carried from the frozen config)
no outcome-informed redefinition: if any cluster turns out under-floor or degenerate, the definition is NOT adjusted; the member is recorded per C-2
duplicate/already-asked layer: global and permanent, unchanged
no trading, cost, or profitability metrics: hold1_ret used solely for labels per the frozen study target; no backtest output

campaign_end_procedure.flip_draw: reuse the frozen campaign-4/5 flip draw (seed 2613983839999682065, M=1000, PCG64, rows-hash verified at use time) — never redrawn

feasibility_check.resolution_note: at M=1000 the minimum representable p is 1/1001; disclosed in the campaign-end record as in the frozen config
